text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Place(x) ::: x is a place.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x is in the South Shetland Islands.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is in Antarctica.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Settlement(y) ::: y is a settlement.
Coast(y) ::: y is a coast.
SouthWest(y) ::: y is on the southwest.
On(y, z) ::: y is on z.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
If place A is located in place B and place B is located in place C, then place A is located in place C. ::: ∀x ∀y ∀z ((LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ LocatedIn(y, z)) → LocatedIn(x, z))
Premises:
Cove(barutin) ∧ NamedAfter(barutin, bulgarianSettlement) ::: Barutin Cove is a cove named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
LocatedIn(barutin, snowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
LocatedIn(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ LocatedIn(greenwichIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ LocatedIn(deceptionIsland, southShetlandIslands) ::: Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island are located in the South Shetland Islands.
LocatedIn(antarctica, southShetlandIslands) ::: Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands.
Conclusion:
LocatedIn(barutin, antarctica) ::: Barutin Cove is located in Antarctica.
